failures.question: 2018 年每个月的订单量相比 2017 年同期增长了多少？
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS month,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018)
       - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017) AS growth
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018) > 0
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 12;
failures.firstSql:
SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS month,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018)
       - COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2017) AS growth
FROM orders
WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
  AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01'
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) = 2018) > 0
ORDER BY 1
LIMIT 12;

failures.question: 每个州的平均配送时长是多少天？
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT c.customer_state,
       ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (s.delivered_at - s.shipped_at)) / 86400)::NUMERIC, 2) AS avg_delivery_days
FROM shipments s
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = s.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE s.delivered_at IS NOT NULL
  AND s.shipped_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY avg_delivery_days DESC
LIMIT 100;

failures.question: 客单价最高的 10 个客户是谁？客单价按订单平均金额算。
failures.generatedSql:
WITH order_amounts AS (
    SELECT order_id,
           SUM(payment_value) AS order_amount
    FROM order_payments
    GROUP BY order_id
)
SELECT c.customer_unique_id,
       ROUND(SUM(oa.order_amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_amounts oa ON oa.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC
LIMIT 10;

       ROUND(SUM(ri.refund_value), 2) AS refund_amount

failures.question: 库存低于安全库存的商品，按仓库、区域、品牌统计数量，列出前 20。
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT w.warehouse_name, r.region_name, b.brand_name, COUNT(DISTINCT i.product_id) AS product_count
FROM inventory i
JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code
JOIN product_brand_map pbm ON pbm.product_id = i.product_id AND pbm.is_current
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = pbm.brand_id
WHERE i.quantity < i.safety_stock
GROUP BY w.warehouse_name, r.region_name, b.brand_name
ORDER BY product_count DESC
LIMIT 20;
failures.firstSql:
SELECT w.warehouse_name, r.region_name, b.brand_name, COUNT(DISTINCT i.product_id) AS product_count
FROM inventory i
JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id
JOIN regions r ON r.region_code = w.region_code
JOIN product_brand_map pbm ON pbm.product_id = i.product_id AND pbm.is_current
JOIN brands b ON b.brand_id = pbm.brand_id
WHERE i.quantity < i.safety_stock
GROUP BY w.warehouse_name, r.region_name, b.brand_name

failures.question: 默认收货地址所在州和客户登记州是否一致的订单量对比，列出前 20。
failures.generatedSql:
SELECT c.customer_state,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE c.customer_state = sa.state) AS same_state_orders,
       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE c.customer_state <> sa.state) AS different_state_orders
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN shipping_addresses sa ON sa.customer_id = c.customer_id AND sa.is_default = true
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) DESC
LIMIT 20;
failures.firstSql:

       COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) FILTER (WHERE c.customer_state <> sa.state) AS different_state_orders
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN shipping_addresses sa ON sa.customer_id = c.customer_id AND sa.is_default = true
GROUP BY c.customer_state
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) DESC
